name: base64
description: Encode or decode base64, RFC 4648 standard alphabet (C). WHEN TO USE: a payload needs to travel through a text-only channel, or an existing base64 blob needs reading. Input: {"text": "...", "mode": "encode"|"decode"} (mode defaults to encode; bare text may be passed unwrapped for encode).
llm_description: Encode/decode base64 (RFC 4648 standard alphabet). Input: {text, mode:'encode'|'decode'} (mode defaults to encode; bare text allowed for encode).

mode.description: encode or decode. Defaults to encode.
